info.title: EinkChess Public Data API
info.summary: Read-only static puzzle dataset served by einkchess.fun.
info.description: EinkChess has no application backend. This describes the static, CORS-enabled puzzle dataset published at the site origin. No authentication is required or supported. Puzzle data originates from the Lichess open puzzle database (CC0).

get.description: JavaScript file declaring PUZZLE_MANIFEST_VERSION (build timestamp) and PUZZLE_MANIFEST (rating bucket -> number of puzzle files). Delivered as JavaScript rather than JSON so legacy Kindle WebKit can load it with a script tag.

get.summary: Puzzle set for a rating bucket

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Rating bucket, 400 to 3400 in steps of 100.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Zero-padded 3-digit file number, starting at 001. The highest valid value for a bucket is the count given in PUZZLE_MANIFEST.

404.description: No such rating bucket or file index

FEN.description: Position before the opponent's setup move

Moves.description: Space-separated UCI moves. The first move is played by the engine to reach the puzzle position; the solver plays every subsequent odd-indexed move.
Moves.example: e5d4 d3d4 f7f6 d4a7 d8e7 a7a6
